title: Prakrama 1, Sarga 13. The Marriage of Sri Vishnupriya: The Consolation of Sri Sanatana
html:
Shachi seeks the daughter of Sanatana Mishra as a bride for her son; the betrothal and the preparations; the Lord pretends to know nothing of the wedding, and the grieved Sanatana and his wife resign themselves; the Lord removes their sorrow

Verse 1

अथावसद्गृहे रम्ये मात्रा सज्जनबन्धुभिः।
मुमोद च सुरैः सार्धं यथादित्या पुरन्दरः॥१॥

athāvasadgṛhe ramye mātrā sajjanabandhubhiḥ|
mumoda ca suraiḥ sārdhaṁ yathādityā purandaraḥ||1||

atha — then; avasat — He lived; grihe — in the house; ramye — charming; matra — with His mother; sajjana-bandhubhih — with good people and kinsmen; mumoda — rejoiced; cha — and; suraih — the gods; sardham — together with; yatha — as; aditya — with Aditi; purandarah — Purandara (Indra).

1Then the Lord lived in His charming home with His mother, with good people and kinsmen, and rejoiced like Purandara1 with Aditi among the gods.

Verse 2

ततः शची चिन्तयित्वा विवाहार्थं सुतस्य सा।
काशीनाथं द्विजश्रेष्ठं प्राह गच्छस्व साम्प्रतम्॥२॥

tataḥ śacī cintayitvā vivāhārthaṁ sutasya sā|
kāśīnāthaṁ dvijaśreṣṭhaṁ prāha gacchasva sāmpratam||2||

tatah — then; shachi — Shachi; chintayitva — having thought; vivaha-artham — about the marriage; sutasya — of her son; sa — she; kashinatham — to Kashinatha; dvija-shreshtham — the best of the twice-born; praha — said; gachchhasva — go; sampratam — now.

2One day Shachi, having thought about her son's marriage, said to Kashinatha, the best of brahmanas: "Go now

Verse 3

श्रीमत्सनातनं विप्रं पण्डितं धर्मिणां वरम्।
वदस्व मम पुत्राय सुतां दातुं यथाविधि॥३॥

śrīmatsanātanaṁ vipraṁ paṇḍitaṁ dharmiṇāṁ varam|
vadasva mama putrāya sutāṁ dātuṁ yathāvidhi||3||

shrimat-sanatanam — to the venerable Sanatana; vipram — the brahmana; panditam — the scholar; dharminam — of the righteous; varam — the best; vadasva — tell; mama — my; putraya — to the son; sutam — his daughter; datum — to give; yatha-vidhi — according to the rite.

3to the venerable brahmana Sanatana, the learned pandita, the best of the righteous, and ask him to give his daughter to my son according to the rite."

Verse 4

तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्याः काशीनाथद्विजोत्तमः।
न्यवेदयत्तत्सकलं पण्डिताय महात्मने॥४॥

tacchrutvā vacanaṁ tasyāḥ kāśīnāthadvijottamaḥ|
nyavedayattatsakalaṁ paṇḍitāya mahātmane||4||

tat — that; shrutva — hearing; vachanam — word; tasyah — her; kashinatha-dvija-uttamah — Kashinatha, the excellent brahmana; nyavedayat — conveyed; tat — that; sakalam — all; panditaya — to the pandita; maha-atmane — high-souled.

4Having heard her words, Kashinatha, that excellent brahmana, conveyed all this to the high-souled pandita.

Verse 5

गच्छ त्वं द्विजशार्दूल कर्तव्यं यत्प्रयोजनम्।
समयं निर्णयं कृत्वा प्राहेष्यामो द्विजोत्तमम्॥५॥

gaccha tvaṁ dvijaśārdūla kartavyaṁ yatprayojanam|
samayaṁ nirṇayaṁ kṛtvā prāheṣyāmo dvijottamam||5||

gachchha — go; tvam — you; dvija-shardula — O tiger among the twice-born; kartavyam — to be done; yat — whatever; prayojanam — business; samayam — the time; nirnayam — settlement; kritva — having made; prahesyamah — we shall send; dvija-uttamam — a worthy brahmana.

5(He replied:) "Go, O tiger among the twice-born. When we have considered what needs to be done and settled the time, we shall send a worthy brahmana (to you)."

Verse 6

तच्छ्रुत्वा सकलं पत्न्या विमृश्य बन्धुभिः सह।
कर्तव्यमेतन्निश्चित्य काशीनाथमथाब्रवीत्॥६॥

tacchrutvā sakalaṁ patnyā vimṛśya bandhubhiḥ saha|
kartavyametanniścitya kāśīnāthamathābravīt||6||

tat — that; shrutva — hearing; sakalam — all; patnya — with his wife; vimrishya — having deliberated; bandhubhih saha — with his kinsmen; kartavyam — to be done; etat — this; nishchitya — having decided; kashinatham — to Kashinatha; atha — then; abravit — he spoke.

6Having heard everything, he consulted with his wife and kinsmen, decided that this ought to be done, and then spoke (thus) to Kashinatha.

Verse 7

श्रुत्वेत्थं वचनं तस्य समागम्य यथोदितम्।
शच्यै न्यवेदयत्सर्वं ततः सा हर्षिताभवत्॥७॥

śrutvetthaṁ vacanaṁ tasya samāgamya yathoditam|
śacyai nyavedayatsarvaṁ tataḥ sā harṣitābhavat||7||

shrutva — hearing; ittham — thus; vachanam — word; tasya — his; samagamya — coming back; yatha-uditam — as it was spoken; shachyai — to Shachi; nyavedayat — reported; sarvam — all; tatah — then; sa — she; harshita — delighted; abhavat — became.

7Hearing his words, Kashinatha returned and reported everything to Shachi just as it had been said, and she was delighted.

Verse 8

ततः कालेन कियता पण्डितः श्रीसनातनः।
शुद्धः स्वाचारनिरतो वैष्णवो लोकपालकः॥८॥

tataḥ kālena kiyatā paṇḍitaḥ śrīsanātanaḥ|
śuddhaḥ svācāranirato vaiṣṇavo lokapālakaḥ||8||

tatah — then; kalena kiyata — after some time; panditah — the pandita; shri-sanatanah — Sri Sanatana; shuddhah — pure; sva-achara-niratah — devoted to his own right conduct; vaishnavah — a Vaishnava; loka-palakah — a protector of people.

8After some time the pandita Sri Sanatana — pure, devoted to right conduct, a Vaishnava, a protector of people,

Verse 9

दयालुरातिथेयश्च सुशीलः प्रियवाक्शुचिः।
प्राहिणोद्ब्राह्मणं कञ्चित्समागत्यानमच्छचीम्॥९॥

dayālurātitheyaśca suśīlaḥ priyavākśuciḥ|
prāhiṇodbrāhmaṇaṁ kañcitsamāgatyānamacchacīm||9||

dayaluh — compassionate; atitheyah — hospitable; cha — and; su-shilah — of good character; priya-vak — kind in speech; shuchih — pure; prahinot — sent; brahmanam — a brahmana; kanchit — a certain; samagatya — having come; anamat — he bowed; shachim — to Shachi.

9compassionate and hospitable, of good character, kind in speech and pure — sent a certain brahmana. He came, bowed to Shachi,

Verse 10

प्राह तां तव पुत्राय पण्डिताय महात्मने।
सुतां सर्वगुणैर्युक्तां रूपौदार्यसमन्विताम्॥१०॥

prāha tāṁ tava putrāya paṇḍitāya mahātmane|
sutāṁ sarvaguṇairyuktāṁ rūpaudāryasamanvitām||10||

praha — said; tam — to her; tava — your; putraya — to the son; panditaya — learned; maha-atmane — high-souled; sutam — his daughter; sarva-gunaih — with all virtues; yuktam — endowed; rupa-audarya-samanvitam — possessed of beauty and nobility.

10and said to her: "O virtuous lady! The pandita Sri Sanatana begs to give to your son, so learned and high-souled,

Verse 11

दातुं प्रार्थयते साध्वि पण्डितः श्रीसनातनः।
ततः प्रमुदिता साध्वी शची वाक्यमथाददे॥११॥

dātuṁ prārthayate sādhvi paṇḍitaḥ śrīsanātanaḥ|
tataḥ pramuditā sādhvī śacī vākyamathādade||11||

datum — to give; prarthayate — begs; sadhvi — O virtuous lady; panditah — the pandita; shri-sanatanah — Sri Sanatana; tatah — then; pramudita — delighted; sadhvi — the virtuous; shachi — Shachi; vakyam — speech; atha — then; adade — took up.

11his daughter, who is endowed with every virtue, with beauty and nobility." Then the virtuous Shachi, delighted, replied:

Verse 12

ममैव सम्मतो नित्यं सम्बन्धः सद्गुणाश्रयः।
कर्तव्यमेतन्नियतं शुभकालमथाह तम्॥१२॥

mamaiva sammato nityaṁ sambandhaḥ sadguṇāśrayaḥ|
kartavyametanniyataṁ śubhakālamathāha tam||12||

mama — to me; eva — indeed; sammatah — agreeable; nityam — always; sambandhah — alliance; sat-guna-ashrayah — the abode of good qualities; kartavyam — to be done; etat — this; niyatam — certainly; shubha-kalam — at an auspicious time; atha — thus; aha — she said; tam — to him.

12"This alliance, the abode of all good qualities, has always been dear to me. It must certainly be performed at an auspicious hour" — so she said to him.

Verse 13

ततो हृष्टो द्विजश्रेष्ठोऽवदन्मधुरया गिरा।
विष्णुप्रिया पतिं प्राप्य तव पुत्रं श्रियान्वितम्॥१३॥

tato hṛṣṭo dvijaśreṣṭho'vadanmadhurayā girā|
viṣṇupriyā patiṁ prāpya tava putraṁ śriyānvitam||13||

tatah — then; hrishtah — delighted; dvija-shreshthah — the best of brahmanas; avadat — said; madhuraya gira — with sweet words; vishnupriya — Vishnupriya; patim — as husband; prapya — having obtained; tava — your; putram — son; shriya-anvitam — endowed with splendour.

13Then the best of brahmanas, delighted, said in a sweet voice: "Having won your splendid son as her husband, may Vishnupriya prove true to her name2.

Verse 14

यथार्थनाम्नी भवतु श्रीमद्विश्वम्भरः प्रभुः।
तामुद्वाह्य यथा कृष्णो रुक्मिणीं प्राप्य निर्वृतः॥१४॥

yathārthanāmnī bhavatu śrīmadviśvambharaḥ prabhuḥ|
tāmudvāhya yathā kṛṣṇo rukmiṇīṁ prāpya nirvṛtaḥ||14||

yathartha-namni — one whose name is true to its meaning; bhavatu — may she become; shrimat-vishvambharah — Srimad Vishvambhara; prabhuh — Prabhu; tam — her; udvahya — having married; yatha — as; krishnah — Krishna; rukminim — Rukmini; prapya — having won; nirvritah — was blissful.

14And may Srimad Vishvambhara Prabhu, having married her, be as blissful

Verse 15

तथा निर्वृतिमाप्नोतु सत्यमेतद्वदामि ते।
इति द्विजेन्द्रवचनं श्रुत्वा हर्षान्विता शची॥१५॥

tathā nirvṛtimāpnotu satyametadvadāmi te|
iti dvijendravacanaṁ śrutvā harṣānvitā śacī||15||

tatha — so; nirvritim — bliss; apnotu — may He attain; satyam — the truth; etat — this; vadami — I speak; te — to you; iti — such; dvija-indra-vachanam — words of the best of brahmanas; shrutva — hearing; harsha-anvita — was filled with joy; shachi — Shachi.

15as Krishna was blissful when He won Rukmini. I am telling you the truth." Hearing these words of the best of brahmanas, Shachi was filled with joy.

Verse 16

द्विजश्च गत्वा तत्सर्वं पण्डिताय न्यवेदयत्।
ततो हर्षान्वितो भूत्वा पण्डितः श्रीसनातनः॥१६॥

dvijaśca gatvā tatsarvaṁ paṇḍitāya nyavedayat|
tato harṣānvito bhūtvā paṇḍitaḥ śrīsanātanaḥ||16||

dvijah — the brahmana; cha — and; gatva — going; tat — that; sarvam — all; panditaya — to the pandita; nyavedayat — reported; tatah — then; harsha-anvitah — filled with joy; bhutva — becoming; panditah — the pandita; shri-sanatanah — Sri Sanatana.

16The brahmana went back and reported everything to the pandita. Then, filled with joy, the pandita Sri Sanatana,

Verse 17

सर्वद्रव्याद्यलङ्कारमाहरत्सत्वरं कृती।
ततः स समयं ज्ञात्वाधिवासं कर्तुमुद्यतः॥१७॥

sarvadravyādyalaṅkāramāharatsatvaraṁ kṛtī|
tataḥ sa samayaṁ jñātvādhivāsaṁ kartumudyataḥ||17||

sarva-dravya-adi-alankaram — all the provisions, ornaments and the rest; aharat — gathered; satvaram — quickly; kriti — the capable man; tatah — then; sah — he; samayam — the time; jnatva — learning; adhivasam — the adhivasa; kartum — to perform; udyatah — made ready.

17a capable man, quickly gathered all the provisions, ornaments and everything else, and then, learning the appointed time, made ready to perform the adhivasa.

Verse 18

ततो गणक आगत्य प्रोवाच विनयान्वितः।
मयाभ्येत्य पथि मुदा श्रीमद्विश्वम्भरः प्रभुः॥१८॥

tato gaṇaka āgatya provāca vinayānvitaḥ|
mayābhyetya pathi mudā śrīmadviśvambharaḥ prabhuḥ||18||

tatah — then; ganakah — the astrologer; agatya — coming; provacha — said; vinaya-anvitah — humbly; maya — by me; abhyetya — approaching; pathi — on the road; muda — gladly; shrimat-vishvambharah — Srimad Vishvambhara; prabhuh — Prabhu.

18Just then the astrologer came and humbly said: "On the road I gladly met Srimad Vishvambhara Prabhu

Verse 19

दृष्टः पृष्टश्च भगवन्नधिवासस्तवानघ।
विवाहस्याद्य किं तत्र विलम्बस्तात दृश्यते॥१९॥

dṛṣṭaḥ pṛṣṭaśca bhagavannadhivāsastavānagha|
vivāhasyādya kiṁ tatra vilambastāta dṛśyate||19||

drishtah — was seen; prishtah — was asked; cha — and; bhagavan — O Bhagavan; adhivasah — adhivasa; tava — Your; anagha — O sinless one; vivahasya — of the wedding; adya — today; kim — why; tatra — there; vilambah — delay; tata — dear one; drishyate — is seen.

19and asked Him: 'O Bhagavan, O sinless one, today is Your adhivasa before the wedding. Why, dear one, do I see delay there?'

Verse 20

तच्छ्रुत्वा प्राह मां देवो राजत्स्मेरमुखाम्बुजः।
कुतः कस्य विवाहस्ते विदितस्तद्वदस्व मे॥२०॥

tacchrutvā prāha māṁ devo rājatsmeramukhāmbujaḥ|
kutaḥ kasya vivāhaste viditastadvadasva me||20||

tat — that; shrutva — hearing; praha — said; mam — to me; devah — the Lord; rajat-smera-mukha-ambujah — whose lotus face shone with a smile; kutah — from where; kasya — whose; vivahah — wedding; te — to you; viditah — known; tat — that; vadasva — tell; me — Me.

20Hearing this, the Lord, His lotus face shining with a smile, answered me: 'Where did you get that? Whose wedding? Tell Me.'

Verse 21

इति श्रुत्वा मया तस्य वचनं तव सन्निधौ।
समागतं निशम्यैतद्यद्युक्तं तत्समाचर॥२१॥

iti śrutvā mayā tasya vacanaṁ tava sannidhau|
samāgataṁ niśamyaitadyadyuktaṁ tatsamācara||21||

iti — such; shrutva — having heard; maya — by me; tasya — His; vachanam — word; tava — your; sannidhau — into the presence; samagatam — I have come; nishamya — having heard; etat — this; yat — what; yuktam — is fitting; tat — that; samachara — do.

21Having heard such words from Him, I have come to you. Now that you have heard this, do whatever is fitting."

Verse 22

इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य गणकस्य सुदुःखितः।
श्रीमत्सनातनो धैर्यमवलम्ब्याब्रवीद्वचः॥२२॥

iti śrutvā vacastasya gaṇakasya suduḥkhitaḥ|
śrīmatsanātano dhairyamavalambyābravīdvacaḥ||22||

iti — such; shrutva — hearing; vachah — words; tasya — of that; ganakasya — astrologer; su-duhkhitah — deeply grieved; shrimat-sanatanah — the venerable Sanatana; dhairyam — fortitude; avalambya — summoning; abravit — spoke; vachah — words.

22Hearing these words of the astrologer, the venerable Sanatana was deeply grieved, but, summoning all his fortitude, he said:

Verse 23

कृतं मयैतत्सकलं द्रव्यालङ्करणानि च।
तथापि तस्य न तत्रादरोऽभूद्दैवदोषतः॥२३॥

kṛtaṁ mayaitatsakalaṁ dravyālaṅkaraṇāni ca|
tathāpi tasya na tatrādaro'bhūddaivadoṣataḥ||23||

kritam — done; maya — by me; etat — this; sakalam — all; dravya-alankaranani — provisions and ornaments; cha — and; tatha api — even so; tasya — on His part; na — no; tatra — for it; adarah — regard; abhut — there was; daiva-doshatah — through the fault of fate.

23"I have prepared everything — the provisions and the ornaments. And yet, through the fault of fate, He has shown no regard for it.

Verse 24

ममात्र किं मया कार्यं नापराध्यामि कुत्रचित्।
ततः सन्त्रस्तहृदया पत्नी तस्य शुचिव्रता॥२४॥

mamātra kiṁ mayā kāryaṁ nāparādhyāmi kutracit|
tataḥ santrastahṛdayā patnī tasya śucivratā||24||

mama — for me; atra — here; kim — what; maya — by me; karyam — to be done; na — not; aparadhyami — I have offended; kutrachit — in any way; tatah — then; santrasta-hridaya — with an anxious heart; patni — wife; tasya — his; shuchi-vrata — pure in her vows.

24What am I to do now? I have given no offence in any way." Then his wife, pure in her vows, her heart anxious —

Verse 25

कुलजा विष्णुभक्ता च पतिसेवापरायणा।
अब्रवीद्दुःखिता दुःखयुक्तं पण्डितसत्तमम्॥२५॥

kulajā viṣṇubhaktā ca patisevāparāyaṇā|
abravīdduḥkhitā duḥkhayuktaṁ paṇḍitasattamam||25||

kula-ja — of noble family; vishnu-bhakta — devoted to Vishnu; cha — and; pati-seva-parayana — wholly given to serving her husband; abravit — spoke; duhkhita — grieved; duhkha-yuktam — to the sorrowful; pandita-sattamam — best of panditas.

25born of a noble family, devoted to Vishnu, wholly given to serving her husband — grieved herself, spoke to that sorrowful best of panditas.

Verse 26

पतिं पतिव्रता वाक्यं न करोति यदा स्वयम्।
श्रीमद्विश्वम्भरो नात्रापराधो मे कथं भवान्॥२६॥

patiṁ pativratā vākyaṁ na karoti yadā svayam|
śrīmadviśvambharo nātrāparādho me kathaṁ bhavān||26||

patim — to her husband; pati-vrata — the faithful wife; vakyam — words; na — not; karoti — does; yada — when; svayam — Himself; shrimat-vishvambharah — Srimad Vishvambhara; na — no; atra — here; aparadhah — fault; me — my (lord); katham — why; bhavan — are you.

26The faithful wife said to her husband: "If Srimad Vishvambhara does not do it of His own accord, the fault is not ours. Why then, my lord,

Verse 27

दुःखितः किन्तु नास्माभिर्वक्तव्यं किञ्चिदण्वपि।
कार्यमेतन्न कर्तव्यं त्यज दुःखं सुखी भव॥२७॥

duḥkhitaḥ kintu nāsmābhirvaktavyaṁ kiñcidaṇvapi|
kāryametanna kartavyaṁ tyaja duḥkhaṁ sukhī bhava||27||

duhkhitah — grieved; kintu — but; na — not; asmabhih — by us; vaktavyam — to be said; kinchit — anything; anu — the least; api — even; karyam — matter; etat — this; na — not; kartavyam — to be pressed; tyaja — give up; duhkham — sorrow; sukhi — happy; bhava — be.

27are you so grieved? It is not for us to say even the least word: we must not press this matter. Give up your sorrow and be happy."

Verse 28

इति तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा प्रियायाः प्रीतिमावहन्।
उवाच बन्धुभिः सार्धमेतदेव सुनिश्चितम्॥२८॥

iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā priyāyāḥ prītimāvahan|
uvāca bandhubhiḥ sārdhametadeva suniścitam||28||

iti — such; tasyah — her; vachah — words; shrutva — hearing; priyayah — of his beloved; pritim — affection; avahan — feeling; uvacha — he said; bandhubhih sardham — together with his kinsmen; etat — this; eva — indeed; su-nishchitam — firmly resolved.

28Hearing these words of his beloved and feeling tenderness for her, he said together with his kinsmen: "This, then, is firmly resolved:

Verse 29

नाकरोद्यदि विप्रेन्द्रो न करिष्याम एव हि।
ततोऽसौ भगवान्ज्ञात्वा दुःखितौ द्विजदम्पती॥२९॥

nākarodyadi viprendro na kariṣyāma eva hi|
tato'sau bhagavānjñātvā duḥkhitau dvijadampatī||29||

na — not; akarot — has done; yadi — if; vipra-indrah — the best of brahmanas; na — not; karishyamah — we shall do; eva hi — then indeed; tatah — then; asau — He; bhagavan — Bhagavan; jnatva — knowing; duhkhitau — grieved; dvija-dampati — the brahmana couple.

29if the best of brahmanas does not do it, neither shall we." And then Bhagavan learned that the brahmana couple were grieving —

Verse 30

रोषेण लज्जया युक्तौ विष्णुभक्तौ विमत्सरौ।
ब्रह्मण्यो भगवान्देवस्तयोर्दुःखमवाहरत्॥३०॥

roṣeṇa lajjayā yuktau viṣṇubhaktau vimatsarau|
brahmaṇyo bhagavāndevastayorduḥkhamavāharat||30||

roshena — by vexation; lajjaya — by shame; yuktau — seized; vishnu-bhaktau — devoted to Vishnu; vimatsarau — free of envy; brahmanyah — kind to brahmanas; bhagavan — Bhagavan; devah — the Lord; tayoh — their; duhkham — sorrow; avaharat — took away.

30that they, devoted to Vishnu and free of envy, were seized with vexation and shame — and the Lord Bhagavan, kind to brahmanas, took away their sorrow.

Thus ends the thirteenth sarga, "The Consolation of Sri Sanatana" (Shri-sanatana-santvana), in the account of Sri Vishnupriya's marriage, of the first prakrama of the great poem "Sri Krishna-chaitanya-charitamrita."

✦

Notes

  1. Purandara is Indra; Aditi is the mother of Indra and the other gods. The Lord, living with His mother among friends, is likened to Indra beside Aditi among the gods.
  2. The name Vishnupriya means "beloved of Vishnu."
